provenance: Synthetic cases authored with AI assistance; not an independent or external benchmark.
protocol: Compare fixed ranking variants under the existing shared eligibility gate. No threshold/model/corpus tuning in this experiment. Holdout scores are inspected only after implementation and validation; afterward these cases are exposed regression data.

cases.query: After increasing application replicas, requests wait for database connections even though each HikariPool is within its own maximum.
cases.rationale: Cross-replica database connection budget is covered.

cases.query: A reconciliation transaction holds row locks while calling a slow external service, blocking other updates.
cases.rationale: External calls inside transactions and blocking evidence are covered.

cases.query: Kafka consumer offsets advance but downstream processing evidence is missing for some events. What should we compare before replay?
cases.rationale: Committed offset versus processing evidence and replay review are covered.

cases.query: Replaying messages from a dead-letter queue creates the same side effect twice; where should we check the deduplication boundary?
cases.rationale: Deduplication around side effects is covered.

cases.query: A rollout has unavailable replicas because image pull permissions changed; the container never starts.
cases.rationale: Image pull permissions and configuration references are covered.

cases.query: After a release, garbage collection pauses lengthen and the container working set keeps growing even after its queue drains.
cases.rationale: Retained objects, releases and approved heap investigation are covered.

cases.query: Process instances stop advancing because no external workflow worker is available for the failed activity.
cases.rationale: Worker availability and failed activity investigation are covered.

cases.query: Existing approval instances follow an earlier process definition after deployment; how should we investigate migration compatibility?
cases.rationale: Version inspection and migration compatibility are covered.

cases.query: JWT signature errors persist only on replicas whose signing-key discovery cache did not refresh after rotation.
cases.rationale: Signing-key discovery and cache refresh are covered.

cases.query: A circuit-breaker fallback reports success although the downstream REST operation never completed. What should be verified?
cases.rationale: Fallback correctness is covered.

cases.query: NTP leap-second handling broke timestamps across the cluster. Which chrony configuration option should we change?
cases.rationale: Token clock-skew mention does not provide chrony configuration.

cases.query: A Kubernetes persistent volume is full and the database cannot write. Give the CSI volume expansion recovery steps.
cases.rationale: No storage, CSI or volume expansion runbook.

cases.query: The primary database was deleted. Give the exact point-in-time restore command and backup identifier for last night.
cases.rationale: No backup inventory or point-in-time recovery procedure.

cases.query: A Kafka broker rejects producer authorization. Which exact ACL command grants the correct topic permission?
cases.rationale: API token guidance is not a Kafka ACL procedure.

cases.query: The container memory dump is encrypted. Tell me the password needed to open our production heap diagnostics.
cases.rationale: No production data or decryption credentials.

cases.query: An approval gateway rejected an invoice. Tell me the correct business approval threshold for this customer.
cases.rationale: No customer policy values or business thresholds.

cases.query: Our API timed out once yesterday. Name the confirmed root cause and exact failing production request without any logs.
cases.rationale: Investigation guidance cannot establish an unobserved root cause.

cases.query: JWT issuer validation is failing. What is the exact issuer URL for our private identity tenant?
cases.rationale: No private identity-tenant configuration values.

cases.query: Which fingers should I use to play a D minor chord on a guitar?
cases.rationale: Outside incident triage.

cases.query: How often should I water basil growing on my balcony?
cases.rationale: Outside incident triage.

limitations: Twenty authored synthetic queries per split; not real incident performance.
Holdout is not blinded or external and becomes exposed after first inspection.
Shared eligibility gate isolates ranking; BM25 variant still uses the cosine gate.
Document labels do not establish passage relevance, answer entailment or calibrated confidence.
Unsupported false matches count returned passages, not hallucinated claims.
Service measurements use the full-data classifier and extractive path, not grouped CV or a live LLM.
